about.title: About / Mission
about.body:
Kongeriket exists to secure a Europe worth handing to the next generation. We research and argue for European strategy, sovereignty and civilizational renewal: the survival, freedom, safety and prosperity of the European peoples.

Norway is early-warning ground, not a country already fallen. Western hard cases (the UK counts as Europe) are a preview of what waits if nothing changes. Eastern and Central Europe hold the line. We act pan-European without equating Europe with the EU.

Founded by Erik Dale. Lean, honest shop. One public face.
